image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a copper-colored metal chain lying diagonally across a light gray background. The chain consists of interlinked oval rings with a high-gloss, reflective metallic finish. The foreground links are in sharp focus, showing clear reflections and structural integrity, while the background links fade into a strong depth-of-field blur. There is faint, illegible text/watermark visible on the left side of the image.
